positioning: Precision pour-over kits for the solo creator who values craft over speed.
persona: A knowledgeable, understated friend who shares the ritual without hype.
do_say_example: Dial in your grind size and pour rate to unlock the natural sweetness of your single-origin beans.
dont_say_example: This is the best pour-over set ever made and will make you a coffee genius instantly. (Reason: Uses 'best' and 'instantly' — exaggerated, inauthentic, and contradicts the brand's honest, understated voice.)
